cohort: All venues; T20 competition rows only; second innings only; 120-ball state model; extra innings excluded.

confirmed_choices.retire_out: Excluded from batter dismissals and averages.
confirmed_choices.activity: At least one role appearance in T20 season 2026 at any venue.
confirmed_choices.recent_form: Latest 10 known T20 second-innings (chase-cohort) player innings across all venues; fewer than 10 is a review sample and does not qualify for ranking.

definitions.batting_pressure: Second innings; 1-30 balls remaining; at least 3 wickets down; required rate >= 15; runs needed > 0.
definitions.bowling_pressure: Second innings; 1-30 balls remaining; 2 or fewer wickets down; current rate >= 11; required rate >= 9; runs needed > 0.
definitions.state_timing: State is pre-delivery. A wide/no-ball row can belong to a state but does not advance legal balls. Unknown-legality rows and all later states are excluded.
definitions.score_and_target: Per requested formula, delivery team score is runs plus one for wide, Overstep/no-ball, bye, or leg-bye; target is revised_target when present, otherwise first-innings total plus one.
definitions.imputation: Byes and leg-byes are imputed as one team run per row because their exported run amount is zero. Wides and no-balls are also counted one each for team score and bowler charges. extras_2_runs is not added by this requested formula.
definitions.batter_dismissals: is_wicket excluding retire out, retired out, retire hurt/retired hurt, and obstruction-of-field labels.
definitions.ordinary_states: Known, positive-runs-needed second-innings chase deliveries not in the corresponding batting- or bowling-pressure state.
definitions.ranking_score: Percentile composite. Batters: 50% adjusted strike-rate percentile + 30% adjusted-average percentile + 20% raw boundary-share percentile. Bowlers: 40% adjusted economy percentile (lower is better) + 40% adjusted wickets/6 percentile + 20% raw dot-share percentile.
definitions.shrinkage: Composite-only: SR uses 60 prior balls; average uses 3 prior dismissals; economy and wickets/6 use 60 prior legal balls. Raw values and adjusted values are both retained in output.
